services.desc: Resurrection River Rafting Tour in Seward, Alaska: Adventure Through Kenai Fjords National Park Introduction Get ready for an unforgettable Resurrection River rafting tour in Seward, Alaska! This one-of-a-kind adventure takes you through the pristine wilderness of Kenai Fjords National Park, offering breathtaking views of Exit Glacier, towering mountains, and lush forests. Perfect for thrill-seekers and nature enthusiasts alike, this guided rafting trip combines the excitement of navigating Class II and III rapids with the serenity of Alaska’s unspoiled beauty. Whether you’re an experienced paddler or a first-timer, this tour is designed to provide an incredible experience for everyone.

faq.q: lease see full FAQ: What kinds of trips do you offer?
faq.a: Our trips can be divided into these main categories: backpacking trips, hiking trips, multi-sport trips, rafting trips, scenic trips, fishing trips, and winter trips. Most of them are fly-in/fly-out, with most trips beginning on the Kenai Peninsula in Homer, Alaska. We offer an assortment of scheduled trips each year and we arrange custom trips for a variety of groups and individuals.
